implemented.rasterParts: Admit the actual RasterPart array before construction (32-byte header). Grow declared capacity before each GPU surface producer and part record/bounds copy: 32 + 168 per part (96 record + 64 independent bounds + 8 slot). Retained cache entries explicitly own this array across frame cleanup. Entry teardown releases native surfaces first, then clears the actual admitted array and its references.
implemented.bounds: Retained parts copy their original computed rectangle into an independent pre-admitted plain record. Computation, dimensions, source offsets, primitive grouping, upload, pixels, shader operators and draw order are unchanged; temporary extent/region arenas can subsequently finish without retaining cache geometry through borrowed aliases.
implemented.callArguments: Original six-slot argument tuples declare 80 bytes before their factory and remain admitted through actual painting/statistics consumption, then clear their references. Original getter/order/call arguments are preserved.
implemented.recordingSurface: When existing paint recording is active, admit the original shallow pixel-surface copy before spread using 64 + 16 per own source field plus the ctx override. It remains admitted through original painting, group rendering and uploads, then drops only its copied references. Original pixel backing and contexts are borrowed and remain owned by their original caller.
implemented.failureCleanup: The metadata-producing section runs inside the existing scratch release path. If part-container admission fails after the raster scratch producer returns, that actual scratch releases. Per-part growth denial precedes GPU creation. Failed native upload preserves the original null error while partial native surfaces, part arrays, keys/controls and argument references release. Original native raster/recording cleanup remains required.
implemented.scope: Selected actual RasterPart containers/records/independent bounds, original call arrays and recording surface copy. Extent/region/native DOM geometry, recording/replay internal structures and other WebGL bounds/device/pool/shader/paint controls remain pending, as do provider keys, retained graphs, font and other checksum structures, ledger controls, Node protocol/result copies and actual production/aggregate admission. Native VM/codec/driver/crypto private storage and RSS are separate.
